description: This file implements the login, signup, and password reset user interface for a Learning Management System (LMS) web application. It manages user authentication flows including login via email/password and Microsoft OAuth, registration with validation, and password recovery/reset workflows. The component handles form states, validation, API interactions, error handling, and UI rendering for desktop and mobile views.

methods.name: getNextAuthErrorMessage
methods.description: Maps NextAuth error codes to human-readable error messages.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login submission, interacting with API, managing errors, and redirection.

methods.name: handleSignupStep1
methods.description: Validates initial signup data (name, email, age, country, phone) and advances to password entry.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Performs final registration API call, handles responses such as pending approval, errors, and redirects.

methods.name: selectEmail
methods.description: Sets the selected email from the saved email dropdown.

methods.name: handleForgotPassword
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by sending a reset request via API.

methods.name: handleResetPassword
methods.description: Completes password resetting with token and new password, handling success and errors.

calls: registerApi({ email, password, name, age, country, phoneNumber })
